SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year LIKE 'FY%'
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_quarter DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(calendar_date) as quarter_start, MAX(calendar_date) as quarter_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_quarter = 4
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.gross_amount - f.standard_cost) as total_gross_margin,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross_sales,
    SUM(f.standard_cost) as total_standard_cost,
    COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.region = 'South'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.gross_amount - f.standard_cost) as total_gross_margin,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.gross_amount - f.standard_cost) / SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) as gross_margin_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.region = 'South'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gross_amount < standard_cost) as negative_margin_lines,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) as distinct_products
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.region = 'South'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE

SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    p.product_name,
    f.quantity,
    f.net_amount,
    f.gross_amount,
    f.standard_cost,
    f.gross_amount - f.standard_cost as margin
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.region = 'South'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  AND f.gross_amount < f.standard_cost
LIMIT 10
